patches.name: миграция старых конфигов catsaken -> skidsaken
patches.anchor: if isfile('skidsakenconfigs.json') and not isfile("skidsakenconfigfix.txt") then
patches.text:
do
    if not isfile('skidsaken_migration_done.txt') then
        pcall(function()
            local Http = game:GetService('HttpService')
            if isfile('catsakenconfigs.json') then
                local s, oldcfg = pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(readfile('catsakenconfigs.json')) end)
                if s and type(oldcfg) == 'table' then
                    local newcfg = {}
                    local sn, d = pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(readfile('skidsakenconfigs.json')) end)
                    if sn and type(d) == 'table' then newcfg = d end
                    for k, v in pairs(oldcfg) do
                        if newcfg[k] == nil then newcfg[k] = v end
                    end
                    writefile('skidsakenconfigs.json', Http:JSONEncode(newcfg))
                end
                delfile('catsakenconfigs.json')
            end
            if isfile('catsakenautoload.txt') then
                writefile('skidsakenautoload.txt', readfile('catsakenautoload.txt'))
                delfile('catsakenautoload.txt')
            end
            if isfile('BOOL_CATSAKEN_OLDUI') then
                writefile('BOOL_SKIDSAKEN_OLDUI', readfile('BOOL_CATSAKEN_OLDUI'))
                delfile('BOOL_CATSAKEN_OLDUI')
            end
            local function movefolder(from, to)
                if not isfolder(from) then return end
                if not isfolder(to) then makefolder(to) end
                for _, p in pairs(listfiles(from)) do
                    local name = p:match('[^/\\]+$') or p
                    pcall(function()
                        writefile(to .. '/' .. name, readfile(from .. '/' .. name))
                        delfile(from .. '/' .. name)
                    end)
                end
                pcall(delfile, from)
            end
            movefolder('Catsaken', 'Skidsaken')
            movefolder('CatsakenRemastered', 'SkidsakenRemastered')
            writefile('skidsaken_migration_done.txt', '')
        end)
    end
end
